Class KnockbackLag

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.server.KnockbackLag
public final class KnockbackLag extends Object
The opponent's own connection to the server. A real player is knocked back by its own game, and its game hears of a hit a moment after the server has dealt it; until the answer is back, the server has it going on as it was. So a player hit on a server stays where a sword reaches it, and can swing back, for a few ticks that a fake player in a singleplayer world does not have: there the hit moves it on the spot. A fighter that has learned its combos on the second kind finds the first kind still in its face.

While a fight is on, a hit's knockback on the one opponent is kept here for as many ticks as the fight says and then applied unchanged. Server thread only.
